content: UEFA's current 2026-28 EURO regulations and 2025 format announcement confirm 12 groups of four or five, 12 group winners and eight best runners-up direct, two host-reserved places, and remaining places via play-offs. Regulations Articles 14, 16, and 23 add the operative rules: two to four play-off places reserved for lowest-ranked runners-up, host-dependent topology, and official overall-ranking tie-breaks. Official rules were checked 2026-08-23.
